interaction_steps.prompt: logx能否支持一下全局添加field功能，或默认加一个serviceName，收集日志想根据服务分索引很不方便

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'PROJECT_BRIEF.md' -g '"'!vendor'"' .. | head -60 && sed -n '1,240p' core/logx/config.go && sed -n '1,240p' core/logx/fields.go && sed -n '1,200p' core/logx/readme-cn.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' core/logx/logs.go && sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/vars.go && sed -n '1,260p' core/logx/logwriter.go && sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/fields_test.go && rg 'ServiceName|serviceName|Set.*Field|Add.*Field' core/logx"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '220,560p' core/logx/logs.go && sed -n '1,300p' core/logx/logger.go && sed -n '1,260p' core/logx/richlogger.go && sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/writer.go && sed -n '1,200p' core/logx/readme.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg 'func output|func (write|marshal)' core/logx -n && rg 'LogConf\\{' --glob '*.go' | head -80 && rg 'ServiceName =' rest zrpc -n | head -60"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '250,330p' core/logx/writer.go && rg 'ServiceName' rest zrpc core/service -n | head -80 && rg 'logx.SetUp|Log.SetUp|SetUp\\(.*Log' -n rest zrpc"

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w core/logx/logs.go core/logx/vars.go core/logx/writer.go && git diff --check && git diff -- core/logx/logs.go core/logx/vars.go core/logx/writer.go core/logx/readme-cn.md core/logx/readme.md && git status --short'
